principle: Machine-readable access lowers retrieval friction; it does not increase normative, semantic, visual, safety, or platform authority. Always resolve the underlying design authority separately.

adapters.name: Primer MCP server
adapters.transfer_boundary: Use Primer knowledge as GitHub/Primer implementation guidance or corroboration. Do not generalize its product conventions into unrelated products without a fit argument.
adapters.license_boundary: Follow Primer/GitHub source and package licenses. Store pointers and NUI-derived decision rules, not copied documentation corpora.

adapters.name: Mantine LLM documentation
adapters.transfer_boundary: Use as current Mantine implementation context when Mantine is selected; it is not a general semantic or aesthetic authority.
adapters.license_boundary: Respect Mantine documentation and package licenses; prefer live references over vendoring generated docs.

adapters.name: Mantine MCP server
adapters.transfer_boundary: Use the server to retrieve current Mantine API facts; choose Mantine through NUI routing, not because MCP is available.
adapters.license_boundary: Respect Mantine terms and package licenses; retrieved documentation remains upstream material.

adapters.name: Mantine agent skills
adapters.transfer_boundary: Use only when the project actually uses Mantine and the task matches the skill boundary.
adapters.license_boundary: Keep skill text upstream; NUI records routing and learned mechanisms rather than copying the files.

adapters.name: shadcn/ui open-code registry
adapters.transfer_boundary: Treat copied code as implementation material to inspect and own; preserve NUI semantic, accessibility and visual-fit gates instead of assuming registry defaults are correct for the product.
adapters.license_boundary: Respect each registry/component license and attribution requirements before importing code.

adapters.name: Carbon MCP
adapters.transfer_boundary: Use Carbon MCP as a live doorway into Carbon when Carbon is an applicable enterprise implementation authority; public-preview status and access constraints remain material.
adapters.license_boundary: Do not mirror MCP-returned corpora into NUI; preserve IBM/Carbon license and access boundaries.

adapters.name: Shopify AI Toolkit
adapters.transfer_boundary: Use only for Shopify platform decisions. Never generalize Shopify component, surface or migration rules into generic commerce UI.
adapters.license_boundary: Follow Shopify API License, Partner terms, package and documentation terms; NUI stores routing metadata, not proprietary platform content.

adapters.name: GSAP official agent skills
adapters.transfer_boundary: Use when GSAP is the selected motion engine; timeline mechanics inform implementation but do not decide whether motion belongs in the experience.
adapters.license_boundary: Official skill repository is MIT at the inspected skill level; verify current repository/package licensing before reuse.

adapters.name: Shopify Dev MCP
adapters.transfer_boundary: Route only inside Shopify contexts and confirm target surface/API version before applying retrieved guidance.
adapters.license_boundary: Respect Shopify developer terms and package licensing; do not persist retrieved platform documentation as NUI-owned knowledge.
